headword: {歴史|れきし}を{紐解|ひもと}く
gloss: to look back at history; to delve into history; to explore the past

definitions.gloss: to examine the background of a subject by tracing it through history; to delve into or explore history
definitions.explanation: A literary, somewhat formal phrase meaning to investigate or narrate the historical background of a person, place, institution, or subject. Literally "to unbind (the cords of) history." The verb {紐解|ひもと}く comes from the old practice of untying the silk cord that held an ancient scroll or book shut in order to read it; the phrase therefore evokes the image of opening up history to examine it closely. Common in magazine articles, documentaries, book titles, and guided tours.

notes:
Literally "to untie (the cord of) history." Composed of ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧ (history) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (object marker) + ⟦{紐解|ひもと}く→紐解く：10518_himotoku⟧ (to unbind, to open a scroll, to read). The verb ⟦{紐解|ひもと}く→紐解く：10518_himotoku⟧ is an older, literary verb originally meaning "to untie the silk cord of a book or scroll in order to open and read it." From this came the modern figurative meaning "to investigate or explore in depth."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歴史|れきし}を{紐解|ひもと}く: to trace / explore history
- {歴史|れきし}を{紐解|ひもと}く⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: as one looks back through history, ...
- {歴史|れきし}を{紐解|ひもと}いてみる: to try delving into history
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紐解|ひもと}く→紐解く：10518_himotoku⟧: to go through the records
- ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紐解|ひもと}く→紐解く：10518_himotoku⟧: to delve into the past

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧: to look back on history — a close synonym, plainer and more neutral in tone.
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{辿|たど}る→辿る：10366_tadoru⟧: to trace the course of history — emphasizes following the chain of events.
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掘|ほ}り{下|さ}げる: to dig deeper into history — emphasizes thorough, analytical investigation.
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遡|さかのぼ}る→遡る：04003_sakanoboru⟧: to go back up through history — emphasizes moving from the present toward the past.

USAGE AND REGISTER:
Literary and somewhat formal. Particularly common in:
- Newspaper and magazine essays
- TV documentaries and their narration
- Museum exhibition texts and audio guides
- Book titles, lecture titles, and travel-guide headings

In casual conversation, speakers more often say ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧いく ("let's look at the history") or ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧ ("to look into the history"). The verb ⟦{紐解|ひもと}く→紐解く：10518_himotoku⟧ gives the phrase a cultured, slightly elegant flavor.

NOTE ON THE VERB FORM:
⟦{紐解|ひもと}く→紐解く：10518_himotoku⟧ is also written {繙|ひもと}く with the single kanji {繙|ひもと} in literary contexts. Either form is correct; ⟦{紐解|ひもと}く→紐解く：10518_himotoku⟧ is more common in modern writing.
